title: 学校であった怖い話S
title_romaji: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi S

layouts.notes: While a choice waits (the u32 at 0x80060DDC is 1). Ten 20-byte records at 0x8015B5E0 each start with a pointer to an answer where it lies in the script (plain Shift-JIS, ended by 00); a record no longer used keeps its old pointer, so the u32 at 0x80060E94 says how many count. The number and dot drawn before each answer are not in memory. The u32 at 0x80060DE8 is the answer the cursor is on. The question is at 0x80061058, in the text buffer's cells, and is empty for a choice shown without one. Read in a replay (docs/replay.md) at 19 choices of two to five answers, not yet on a device.

The text as it types, whenever no choice waits. The stretch being shown is copied to 0x80061858 as 16-bit cells, and the u32 at 0x80060D18 counts the cells typed so far: the message is what is on screen and grows as it types. 0xFF01 ends a page, 0xFF02 is a wait inside a row, 0xFF03 an automatic wrap (13 characters a column); 0xFF04 is not known. The u32 at 0x80060CFC is 0 between stretches. A choice's answers are typed through this buffer one by one before the choice waits, so the message is then the answer being typed. Read in a replay (docs/replay.md) at 42 moments, not yet on a device.

sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 1,308,331 characters of prose-like text
Genkan memory search during play: menus in Shift-JIS (story not reached)
Headless replay from power-on into the first story (docs/replay.md): memory read at 42 moments, one choice included
Layout: the same 42 moments read again with the buffer's control cells told apart, each compared with its screenshot
Choices: a second replay through 19 choices of two to five answers; the count read right at all 19, and question, answers and cursor were compared with the screenshot at six
notes: In memory the script is plain Shift-JIS with CRLF line ends, a full-width yen sign and p at each page end, and a choice's answers as bare strings among its instructions. The stretch being shown is laid out into a buffer of 16-bit cells at 0x80061858 (the Shift-JIS code as a little-endian number, 0x0D0A for a line break, 0x0000 at the end), which the layout reads. u32 at 0x80060D00: 0 while text appears, 2 waiting at a line end, 3 waiting at a page end. Text is vertical, 13 characters to a column. A waiting choice has a layout of its own: its answers are read where they lie in the script.
